privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.draftNotice: This policy is a draft. Fill in the operator's details, and we recommend having an expert review it before publishing.
privacyPolicy.intro: The operator of Jaziba (the "Service") handles users' personal information as follows.
privacyPolicy.unfilled: (to be filled in by the operator)

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
items: Account: email address, name, password (stored in a form that can't be reversed), and the public key of any passkey you register
Optional details: nationality, birth year, travel style (companions, accessibility or language needs, favorite categories), and your trip's starting point
What you post or provide: photos, videos, text and places. When you provide photos or videos to a municipality, whether you want your name shown
Activity: likes, comments, saves and views; trip plans and records of transport and travel time; stamps (visits); point and coupon exchanges and use; how many times you used AI features

Location: your current location when collecting a stamp (only used to check you're nearby; not stored). Your location while “Share location” is on in a trip plan (shown only to members of that trip, not stored, gone when you turn it off). Location and direction for AR and the compass are used only on your device
Paid plans: payments are processed by Stripe. We store only your Stripe customer ID, your plan and its period; we never receive your card number
Push notifications: if you turn them on, the delivery address your browser issues
Inquiries: your name, email address and message

IP address: used to prevent abuse (many actions in a short time), to count AI uses for visitors who aren't logged in, and to roughly guess a default nationality at sign-up. It isn't stored in our database, and the guess is made on our server only
On your device: login state, language and display settings, recently viewed posts and offline trip plans are kept in your browser's storage. We don't use cookies for advertising or analytics

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
items: To provide the Service (showing posts, trip plans, stamps, points, coupons, notifications and more)
To personalize recommendations and the display language
To provide paid plans and charge for them
To answer inquiries
To prevent abuse and keep the Service safe
To improve features and understand how the Service is used
To produce statistics for municipalities and businesses (aggregated so no individual can be identified)

sections.heading: 3. What municipalities, businesses and other users see
items: Statistics: viewers' nationality and age group, and trends in starting regions and transport, are shown only in aggregate. Starting points with few people aren't named
Coupons: when a shop checks a coupon code, the holder's name (never the email address)
Provided photos and videos: your name and what you provided, with its place, go to that municipality. If used in a post, your name appears on it if you chose to show it
Comments and likes are visible to other users
If you share a trip plan, people you invite or who have the link can see it

sections.heading: 4. Information sent to outside services
sections.body: To provide features we use the services below and send them what they need. Many of these companies are outside Japan, such as in the United States, and handle the information under their own privacy policies. Maps and fonts load directly from your device, so your IP address and similar information reach those companies.
items: Anthropic (US): the text, photos and trip details when you use AI features (trip concierge, photo search, AI plans, AI trip making, translation). We never send your name or email address
Google (US): starting points and destinations for route search (Google Maps Platform); loading fonts (Google Fonts)
Stripe (US): your email address, name and card details for paid plans (you enter card details directly on Stripe's page)
Notification delivery services (Google, Apple, Mozilla and others that make your browser): the content of push notifications (sent encrypted)
Rakuten Group (Japan): the place's location, dates and number of guests to search for rooms (no user information is sent). “Book” opens Rakuten Travel, where the booking is made
OpenFreeMap: loading map images
Open-Meteo: locations of tourist spots for weather forecasts (no user information is sent)
Render (US): hosting the Service's servers and data

When you press “Continue in your own AI”, ChatGPT (OpenAI, US) or Claude (Anthropic, US) opens in your browser with your trip plan or conversation written in. Jaziba sends nothing; you decide there whether to send it
Where your device has built-in AI (such as in Chrome) for translating, summarizing or polishing text, it is processed on your device and not sent anywhere

sections.heading: 5. Sharing with third parties
sections.body: Except where required by law, or where needed to protect someone's life, body or property and your consent is hard to obtain, we don't give your personal information to third parties without your consent. What is described in 3 and 4 happens through your own actions or as work entrusted to providers so that we can run the Service.

sections.heading: 6. Retention and deletion
items: You can delete your account anytime in Settings. This also deletes related information such as posts, comments, likes, trip plans, points and coupons, and can't be undone
Photos and videos you provided that a municipality posted stay as that municipality's posts after account deletion (your name is removed from them)
If you delete your account while on a paid plan, the plan is cancelled too. Payment records are kept by Stripe for the period required by law
View records stay in statistics after account deletion, in a form not linked to you
Server access logs may be kept for a period by our hosting provider
Inquiries are kept separately from accounts, for handling and records

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: Connections are encrypted with HTTPS, and passwords are stored in a form that can't be reversed. Card details never pass through our servers.

sections.heading: 8. Requests for disclosure, correction or deletion
sections.body: You can view, change and delete your own information in Settings. For other requests, such as disclosure, correction or stopping use, please use the contact form. We will confirm your identity and respond as required by law.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We'll announce changes on this page, and in the app for major changes.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: For questions about this policy, please use the contact form.

paste.hint: Copy or share the route you chose in a transit app or site (e.g. Yahoo! Norikae Annai) and paste it here. Stations, times, line and platform are read from it.
paste.placeholder: e.g. Tokyo 08:52 dep → Nagano 10:24 arr Kagayaki 505
paste.clipboardDenied: Couldn't paste. Long-press the box and paste there
paste.failed: Couldn't find the times. Fill in the fields below instead
paste.incomplete: A station name couldn't be read for some rides. Check and save them one by one
paste.firstFilled: The first ride is filled in below
paste.noDate: No date in the text, so {{date}} is used

transit.alarmBody: Arriving at {{place}} in about {{minutes}} minutes. Get ready to get off
transit.timesNote: These are the scheduled times you entered. Check live status for delays. The screen stays on while this is open.

album.heading: Trip album
album.empty: Add your trip photos and they're sorted by the place they were taken, for everyone on the trip to see.
album.privacy: Only this trip's members can see these photos. Where and when each was taken is read on your device, and photos are shrunk there before sending, which removes location and other metadata.

origin.notFound: The starting point couldn't be found, so this is a rough guess from the name. A station, city or address gives an accurate result

credit.station: Station positions: edited from MLIT National Land Numerical Information (railway data)
credit.town: Address positions: Geolonia address data (CC BY 4.0)

legOption.heading: Ways from {{from}} to {{to}}
legOption.removeConfirm: Delete this way? (Its rides are deleted too.)

titlePlaceholder.car: e.g. Rental car via Chuo Expwy

legOption.minutesFromRides: Left empty, {{duration}} from the rides is used
legOption.ridesNote: Rides of the way you go are used for the ride list, ride mode and departure/arrival alerts.
legOption.notePlaceholder: e.g. Less crowded / parking / easy transfer
legOption.chooseNote: The way you go sets this leg's time in the trip plan (one per leg).
legOption.fareTotal_one: Fares of the ways you chose ({{count}} leg): ¥{{yen}}
legOption.fareTotal_other: Fares of the ways you chose ({{count}} legs): ¥{{yen}}
legOption.tooEarly: The {{time}} ride leaves {{minutes}} min before you plan to leave. Shorten the stay to make it
legOption.waitBefore: {{minutes}} min to wait for the {{time}} ride

checkin.missing: This tag doesn't work. It may have been replaced.
checkin.error: Couldn't load. Open it again where the signal is good.
checkin.loginToGet: Log in and this place's stamp is yours.
checkin.login: Log in to get the stamp

checkinTag.heading: On-site stamp tag (NFC / QR)
checkinTag.intro: Make an NFC tag or QR code to put at this place. Travelers who tap it (or scan the QR) get the stamp without location.

writing.waiting: Hold an NFC tag to the back of the phone…
writing.failed: Couldn't write. Hold the tag again (locked tags can't be written)

checkinTag.noWebNfc: This browser can't write NFC tags. Open this in Chrome on Android, or write the URL with any NFC app (iPhone and Android can both read it).
checkinTag.remakeConfirm: A new one stops the current NFC tags and QR codes working. Make a new one?
checkinTag.removeConfirm: Remove this tag? The current NFC tags and QR codes stop working.
checkinTag.note: Anyone with the URL can open it, so if a photo of the QR gets around, "Make a new one" turns the old one off.

commentSummary.sub: Your device's AI sums up the comments (nothing sent, free)
commentSummary.note: Summarized by the AI on your device. Check the comments themselves too.
commentSummary.context: Comments travelers wrote on a post about a tourist spot. Sum up the good points, cautions and tips briefly.

submit.ctaSub: {{name}} may use them in its posts. {{points}} points when approved
submit.title: Offer photos/videos to {{name}}
submit.intro: Send photos or videos you took in {{name}}. When {{name}} approves one you get 100 points, and it may be featured as a {{name}} post.
submit.pick: Choose a photo or video (videos up to 200 MB)
submit.tooBig: The video is too large (200 MB max)
submit.hasPlace: Read where the photo was taken (only the place is sent)
submit.noPlace: No location in the photo. Add a place name if you like
submit.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Kappa Bridge at 7 a.m., as the mist cleared
submit.credit: Show my name as the contributor when it is posted
submit.consent: I took this myself and agree that {{name}} and Jaziba may use it in posts (anyone recognizable in it has agreed)
submit.note: Photos are shrunk on this device before sending, removing location and other attached data. You can withdraw one under review from My page.
submit.sent: Sent to {{name}}. You will hear the result on My page and in notifications

inbox.intro: Photos and videos travelers offered. Approving one gives the contributor {{points}} points; then you can post it as your own post.
inbox.notePlaceholder: A reason for the contributor (optional), e.g. faces are clearly visible
inbox.postAnonymous: The contributor asked to stay anonymous, so it will show "By a traveler".
inbox.photoNote: The photo becomes a 6-second, slowly zooming vertical video on this device before posting (keep this screen open meanwhile).
inbox.making: Making a video from the photo… {{percent}}%
inbox.cantMake: This browser can't make a video from a photo. Open this in a recent Chrome or Safari
inbox.posted: Posted. The contributor has been told

aiLimit.signedIn: You've used this month's or today's free AI. Exchange points for AI tickets, or upgrade to Plus to keep going.
aiLimit.visitor: Without logging in, AI is limited to 3 times a day. Log in for 30 free uses a month.
aiLimit.planUsed: You've used your plan's AI for now. Exchange points for AI tickets to keep going.

points.title: Points & coupons
points.earnedSpent: {{earned}} pt earned, {{spent}} pt used so far
points.loginNote: Log in to exchange your points for coupons and AI tickets.
points.howToEarn: Earn points: on-site stamps (20 pt), travel time reports (10 pt), photos/videos a municipality approves (100 pt).
points.noCoupons: No coupons to exchange right now
points.exchangeConfirm: Exchange {{points}} pt for "{{title}}"? (Points are not returned)
points.exchanged: Got "{{title}}". Show the code at the shop
points.error: Something went wrong. Please try again
points.aiIntro: Signed in, AI features are free up to {{free}} uses a month ({{perDay}} a day). Beyond that, each use takes one AI ticket.
points.aiLeft: Free this month: {{month}}/{{perMonth}} left ({{today}} today) · AI tickets: {{credits}}
points.aiNote: Free uses reset on the 1st of each month (Japan time). AI tickets don't expire. Translations don't count. When busy, the app may answer without AI (that doesn't count).
points.noneHeld: You don't have any coupons yet
points.useConfirm: Press this in front of the staff. Mark it used? (This cannot be undone)

feature.tripCompose: AI trip (builds the plan for you)

points.planCta: With Plus you get up to {{count}} uses a month

coupons.intro: Offer coupons travelers can get for the points they've collected. They show the code or QR at your shop, or press Use there. Enter a code under Check a coupon to see if it's genuine or already used, and mark it used.
coupons.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Free large soba / ¥100 off the hot spring
coupons.termsPlaceholder: e.g. One per bill, not with other discounts
coupons.scan: Scan the QR with the camera
coupons.planLimit: With a paid plan you can publish more coupons at once.

captionAssist.heading: Polish the text with on-device AI
captionAssist.note: A suggestion from the AI on your device (nothing sent, free). Check it says nothing untrue.
captionAssist.context: A tourism post by a municipality or a local business. Make people want to go there. Don't change the facts, and don't add anything that isn't written (prices, hours, numbers).

qrScan.title: Scan a coupon QR
qrScan.hint: Fit the traveler's coupon QR code inside the frame
qrScan.noCamera: Couldn't use the camera. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the code

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: The basics stay free. Paid plans are for those who use AI a lot or want to offer more coupons.

feature.ai: AI features: {{month}} uses a month (up to {{day}} a day)
feature.basics: Browse posts, trip plans, stamps and other basics
feature.points: Earn points and exchange them for coupons and AI tickets
feature.coupons: Up to {{count}} coupons published at once

plans.endsOn: Ends on {{date}} (you can use it until then)
plans.pastDue: We couldn't take your payment. Check your card in “Manage plan”.
plans.paymentsNotReady: Payments are being set up. Please check back soon.
plans.checkoutPending: This is taking a while. Please reopen this page in a few minutes.
plans.checkoutCancel: Your sign-up was cancelled. You haven't been charged.
plans.error: Something went wrong. Please try again
plans.note: Payments are processed by Stripe; Jaziba never stores your card number. Cancel anytime and keep using the plan until the end of the period. No prorated refunds.

commerce.title: Legal notice (Specified Commercial Transactions Act)
commerce.draftNotice: This notice is a draft. The operator must review it and fill in the blanks before publishing.
commerce.unfilled: (to be filled in by the operator)
commerce.priceValue: Shown on the plans page (tax incl.). Plus 480 yen/month, Business 2,000 yen/month. Municipality Pro by quote.
commerce.extraCostValue: Internet connection and data charges are paid by the customer.
commerce.paymentValue: Credit card (Stripe). Municipality Pro by invoice.
commerce.timingValue: The first payment is made when you subscribe; it then renews and is charged automatically on the same day each month.
commerce.cancelValue: Cancel anytime from “Manage plan”. You can keep using it until the end of the paid period. As a digital service, paid fees are not refunded (including prorated amounts).
commerce.environmentValue: Latest Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox

ownAi.heading: Continue in your own AI
ownAi.copied: Copied. Paste it into your AI
ownAi.note: Your ChatGPT or Claude opens with this already written in. Jaziba doesn't send anything; that service's terms and prices apply, and it doesn't count toward Jaziba's AI uses.

trip.intro: I'd like advice on this trip plan.
trip.ask: Is this schedule realistic? Please suggest ways to enjoy it more, and what to bring or watch out for.

chat.intro: This continues a conversation about travel in Japan with the AI of Jaziba, a tourism social app.

localTransit.heading: Local transport
localTransit.sub: Provided by the municipality and local businesses. Please also check the latest service with them.
localTransit.aiDrafted: Read from the material by AI and checked by the provider
localTransit.manageIntro: Add transport information that's only on your website or leaflets (community buses, shared taxis, shuttles, seasonal services) from a screenshot or PDF. AI can read out the key points. It appears on the spots' access pages.
localTransit.fileHint: An image (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or PDF, up to 15MB. Travelers can see the file too. AI reading counts as one use.
localTransit.checkAi: This is an AI draft. Check that times, fares and phone numbers match the material before publishing.
localTransit.readError: AI couldn't read it. Please type the details
localTransit.bodyPlaceholder:
・Days and hours
・Main stops
・Fares
・How to reserve
localTransit.saveError: Something went wrong. Please try again

admin.title: Jaziba Admin
admin.loginFirst: Log in with an admin account.
admin.notAllowed: This account doesn't have admin access.

overview.sub: How Jaziba is doing right now.
overview.cardOnly: Monthly total of card-paid plans (invoice plans not included)
overview.noAi: No AI use this month yet
overview.aiNote: Estimated from tokens at list prices (1 USD = {{rate}} yen). Check Anthropic's invoice for exact amounts.

users.sub: Search by name, email, municipality or business.
users.stripeNote: This is a card plan. Change or cancel it in the Stripe dashboard.

reports.sub: Comments other users reported. Three reports hide a comment automatically.
reports.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? This can't be undone.

log.sub: What was done in the admin site.

admin.hintNotConfigured: No admin email is set on the server yet. Save ADMIN_EMAILS under Environment in Render, then run Manual Deploy (or restart) for it to take effect.
admin.hintNotListed: This email isn't in ADMIN_EMAILS. Sign in with the account whose address you put there (check for typos).

approvals.sub: New municipality and business sign-ups. Until approved they can't post or edit, and a municipality's page isn't public.
approvals.sameName: Other pages have the same name: {{list}}. Make sure this isn't impersonation.
approvals.howToCheck: How to check (for example): call the department via the main number on the official website; see whether the email domain is official; for a business, check its address or website.
approvals.rejectReason: Why not approve “{{name}}”? (shown on their dashboard)

integrations.heading: Connected services
integrations.note: Shows only whether each setting is in Render's Environment (never the values). After changing settings, run Save, rebuild, and deploy.

approval.pendingBody: Until then you can look around but not post or edit. We may contact you to confirm.
approval.rejectedBody: Please contact us through the contact form.
approval.registerNote: After you sign up, we check the details to prevent impersonation. Once approved you can post and edit your information (we may contact you to confirm).

stays.heading: Find & book a stay
stays.sub: Enter your dates to see places nearby with rooms free and their prices, from Rakuten Travel.
stays.error: We can't check rooms right now. Please try again later
stays.notConfigured: The Rakuten Travel connection isn't set up yet. You can look for places to stay on the map.
stays.noPosition: We don't know where this place is, so we can't check rooms. You can look on the map.
stays.mapSearch: Find places to stay on the map
stays.none: No rooms free within 3 km for these dates. Try other dates or guests.
stays.allPlans: See other plans on Rakuten Travel
stays.note: Rooms and prices are Rakuten Travel's and may change. Booking, payment and cancellation are done on Rakuten Travel.
stays.affiliate: [Ad] Jaziba may receive a referral fee when you book through these links (your price is the same).
stays.pickDates: Pick dates and tap “Search rooms” to see rooms free and prices.
stays.linkHeading: Link to a Rakuten Travel listing
stays.linkedTo: Linked: {{name}} (travelers can check rooms and book from the post)
stays.linkNone: Not linked yet. A place with the same name nearby is linked automatically.
stays.noCandidates: No Rakuten Travel listings within 1 km
